draft.subject: Plobal Apps — Japan rollout for tea retail mobile ordering
draft.body:
Hi Plobal Apps team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama company supporting commerce technology firms in Japan. We’re contacting Plobal Apps about mobile ordering and replenishment campaigns for Japanese Shopify specialty tea retailers serving online and store customers.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean retail teams, targeted push alerts and in-app pickup flows could keep seasonal releases and repeat orders moving without separate campaign operations.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide Japanese app navigation, notification cadence, and pickup workflow. Can we help plan and execute Plobal Apps’ rollout with this retailer segment?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
